lines.en: label utadorm5:
I knock on Uta’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Uta 的门，等她来开。

lines.en: if iodorm5 == False:
I haven’t been inside of her room yet, so I’m a little bit curious as to how things are set up in there.
lines.zh: 我还没进过她的房间，所以有点好奇里面是怎么布置的。

lines.en: Uta seems like the type to either keep things really neat or completely destroy everything in her path, so I’m interested in finding out which of the two is true.
lines.zh: Uta 看起来像是那种要么把东西收拾得井井有条、要么把路上的一切都毁掉的人，所以我很有兴趣搞清楚她到底是哪种。

lines.en: else:
The last time I was in here, it was with Io and...
lines.zh: 我上次来这儿的时候，是和 Io 一起，而且……

lines.en: Well, let’s just say the room wasn’t exactly how I expected it to be.
lines.zh: 好吧，只能说那房间跟我预想的完全不一样。

lines.en: : Ooh! My first visitor!
lines.zh: : 哦！我的第一个访客！

lines.en: : Who’s there?
lines.zh: : 谁啊？

lines.en: : You're not here to kill me, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不是来杀我的吧？

lines.en: : It’s me. Are you free right now?
lines.zh: : 是我。你现在有空吗？

lines.en: : Sensei? Yeah, sure! Come on in.
lines.zh: : Sensei？有啊，当然！进来吧。

lines.en: : I just cleaned up so you’re all good.
lines.zh: : 我刚收拾完，所以你放心。

lines.en: if iodorm5 == False:
Oh, I guess she leans more toward the clean side after all.
lines.zh: 哦，看来她果然更偏向干净那一派。

lines.en: else:
Oh, good. I guess Io must have said something about my impression of the dorm when I went in there with her.
lines.zh: 哦，好。看来 Io 一定跟她提过我和她一起进屋时我对宿舍的印象。

lines.en: scene black
I try to push the door open but it gets stuck on something and I need to squeeze my way into the room instead of walking in like a normal human being.
lines.zh: 我试着推开门，可门被什么东西卡住了，我得挤着身子进屋，而不能像个正常人一样走进去。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm1
: {i}This{/i} is your idea of clean?
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是你所谓的干净？

lines.en: if iodorm5 == True:
It looks exactly the same as it did when I was in here with Io...
lines.zh: 看起来跟我和 Io 在这儿的时候一模一样……

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm2
: Do you mean to tell me your room is cleaner than this, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你是想告诉我，你的房间比这还干净吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Yes. I do mean to tell you that.
lines.zh: : 对。我就是想告诉你这个。

lines.en: : Wow, that’s actually really surprising.
lines.zh: : 哇，那还真挺让人意外的。

lines.en: : I thought you’d be the type to leave things a total wreck.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你是那种把东西弄得一团糟的人呢。

lines.en: : Like a...naughty magazines and tissues all over the place kind of wreck.
lines.zh: : 比如说……满地都是色情杂志和纸巾的那种一团糟。

lines.en: : I’m sure you know what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你懂我在说什么。

lines.en: : Yeah, it doesn't exactly take a rocket scientist to figure it out.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这又不需要什么火箭科学家才想得明白。

lines.en: : I remember when I used to be allowed to buy porn. Those were the good old days.
lines.zh: : 我还记得以前我还能买色情片的时候。那可真是美好的旧时光。

lines.en: Damn you, Makoto.
lines.zh: 该死的，Makoto。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm3
: How bad do you need to mess up to be banned from buying that kind of stuff?
lines.zh: : 你得搞砸到什么程度，才会被禁止买那种东西？

lines.en: : Sometimes, you’re just in the wrong place at the wrong time.
lines.zh: : 有时候，你只是在错误的时间出现在了错误的地点。

lines.en: : Which, coincidentally, is how I’m feeling in your room right now.
lines.zh: 巧的是，我现在在你房间里正是这种感觉。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm4
: {i}Ahem...{/i}Are you even allowed in here in the first place, Sensei?
lines.zh: : {i}咳咳……{/i}话说回来，Sensei，你本来被允许进这儿吗？

lines.en: : I am a young, innocent girl and you are an older, stronger man who could take advantage of me at any moment.
lines.zh: : 我可是个年幼无辜的女孩，而你是个年纪更大、更强壮的男人，随时都可能占我便宜。

lines.en: : Where? I wouldn’t even have any room to do that if I tried.
lines.zh: : 占哪儿？就算我想，这儿连让我下手的地方都没有。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm5
: At least acknowledge that I only recently moved in and that some of this is just temporary clutter!
lines.zh: : 至少你得承认我才刚搬进来不久，其中一些只是临时堆着的东西！

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to insult you. I just figured things might be a little neater since you’re a {i}maid{/i} and all that.
lines.zh: : 我不是想冒犯你。我只是觉得，既然你是{i}女仆{/i}什么的，屋里应该会稍微整齐一点。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm6
: Uta-chan is off tonight, Sensei. And she wouldn’t want to spend her free time being a maid in her very own room even if she weren’t.
lines.zh: : Uta 酱今晚下班了，Sensei。而且就算没下班，她也不会愿意在自己的房间里把空闲时间花在当女仆上。

lines.en: : However, if you act now, you can still hire Uta-chan’s exceptional maid services for your very own tissue-filled house.
lines.zh: : 不过，现在行动还来得及——你依然可以雇佣 Uta 酱超凡的女仆服务，去你那间满是纸巾的房子里服务。

lines.en: : There is also a special VIP package available where Uta-chan will lay on your bed for two hours so your sheets will smell like her.
lines.zh: : 另外还有一个 VIP 特惠套餐：Uta 酱会在你的床上躺两个小时，好让你的床单沾上她的味道。

lines.en: : And I’m assuming the catch is that I’m not allowed to lay with you?
lines.zh: : 那我猜，条件是我不许跟你一起躺？

lines.en: : Of course not.
lines.zh: : 当然不行。

lines.en: : That just sounds like I’d be paying you to come to my house and take a nap.
lines.zh: : 那不就成了我花钱请你来我家睡午觉。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm7
: Exactly. But it’s one step closer toward your ultimate goal of getting freaky with Uta-chan so I figured you’d buy-in right away.
lines.zh: : 正是。不过这离你跟 Uta 酱干点坏事的终极目标又近了一步，所以我猜你一定会立刻买单。

lines.en: : Not if I have to pay. I already have Ami to-
lines.zh: : 如果要花钱就不行。我已经有 Ami 来——

lines.en: : To clean up all of the tissues?
lines.zh: : 来清理所有的纸巾？

lines.en: : To clean the entire house so I can continue laying around being useless.
lines.zh: : 来打扫整栋房子，好让我继续躺着当个废物。

lines.en: : You sound more proud of that than you probably should be.
lines.zh: : 你对这件事的自豪感，大概比应有的多了点。

lines.en: : And you sound a little too confident in the sales pitch for your napping-service.
lines.zh: : 而你对自己的午睡服务推销，听起来也自信过头了点。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm8
: That aside, do you really think it’s that bad in here? It wouldn’t make me happy if you thought I was lazy and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 撇开这些不谈，你真觉得这儿有那么糟吗？要是你觉得我懒什么的，我会不开心的。

lines.en: : It doesn’t smell weird, too, does it?
lines.zh: : 这里也没有什么怪味吧？

lines.en: : The smell is fine.
lines.zh: : 气味没问题。

lines.en: : Cool cause I just spent way too much money on a bunch of essential oils from some flea market I went to with Io and I really needed to hear that it wasn’t a waste.
lines.zh: : 那就好，因为我刚在和 Io 逛的某个跳蚤市场上花了一大笔钱买精油，我真的很需要听你说那钱没白花。

lines.en: : It’s just really...unorganized. I guess that's a good word to use here.
lines.zh: : 只是真的……很乱。我想用这个词比较合适。

lines.en: : Well, we’ve got a lot of stuff and only a little room to put it all in.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们东西很多，而能放东西的地方又很小。

lines.en: : Like, how am I supposed to fit two whole wardrobes on my side of the dorm?
lines.zh: : 比如说，我这边宿舍怎么可能塞得下整整两个衣柜？

lines.en: : Those are both yours? I thought one was Io’s?
lines.zh: : 那两个都是你的？我还以为有一个是 Io 的？

lines.en: : Nope, both mine.
lines.zh: : 不，两个都是我的。

lines.en: : Then where do her clothes go?
lines.zh: : 那她的衣服放哪儿？

lines.en: : Beats me. Maybe she’s hiding them all under the bed so no one can see them?
lines.zh: : 鬼知道。也许她全藏在床底下，好不让别人看见？

lines.en: : And why are your clothes all over the floor if you have two wardrobes?
lines.zh: : 那你既然有两个衣柜，衣服为什么还满地都是？

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm9
: Are you only here to hurt me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你来这儿就是为了伤我的心吗？

lines.en: : After I opened my door {i}and{/i} my heart to you?
lines.zh: : 在我向你敞开大门{i}又{/i}敞开内心之后？

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm2
: Hey, wait a second, why did I open my door for you, anyway?
lines.zh: : 嘿，等等，我到底为什么要给你开门啊？

lines.en: : Isn’t it a little weird for us to be hanging out together like this?
lines.zh: : 我们像这样混在一起，是不是有点奇怪？

lines.en: : I know that you’re in love with me and that it’s probably very hard to stay away, but you need to be careful or someone will think something of it.
lines.zh: : 我知道你爱我爱得不行，忍着不来见我大概很难，可你得小心点，不然别人会说闲话的。

lines.en: : To be honest, you’ll probably see me around here a lot from now on.
lines.zh: : 说实话，从今往后你大概会经常在这儿见到我。

lines.en: : And that’s totally normal?
lines.zh: : 而那完全正常？

lines.en: : Normal for me, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少对我来说正常。

lines.en: : I don’t really get it.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白。

lines.en: : Isn’t there some sort of security-person that should be keeping you away from all of us or can this[school] just not afford something like that?
lines.zh: : 不是该有什么安保人员拦着你、不让你接近我们吗，还是说这所[school]根本雇不起那样的人？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure it’s just more of the[school] not expecting someone like me to actually do something like this.
lines.zh: : 我敢说，更多是因为这所[school]没料到像我这样的人真会干出这种事。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s definitely a little weird no matter how you look at it.
lines.zh: : 是呀，不管怎么看都确实有点怪。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm10
: Well, like I said, I understand how hard it must be for you to stay away.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就像我说的，我理解忍着不来见你有多难。

lines.en: : So I will keep these late-night meetings a secret until further notice.
lines.zh: : 所以，在另行通知之前，我会替你保守这些深夜约会的秘密。

lines.en: : I do have one condition, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我有一个条件。

lines.en: : It's okay to stare at my clothes on the ground but if you start picking them up and sniffing them I will definitely be weirded out. Don’t do that.
lines.zh: : 盯着我地上的衣服看没关系，但如果你开始把它们捡起来闻，我肯定会觉得恶心。别那么做。

lines.en: : I can’t say that’s a thing I was planning on doing.
lines.zh: : 我可不能说那是我原本打算做的事。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm11
: Well then okey-dokey, artichokey! We’ve got ourselves a secret!
lines.zh: : 那么一言为定，茄子开花！我们之间有秘密了！

lines.en: : Awesome. Not sure if I’d call it a secret, though, since I also hang out with the other girls in their rooms.
lines.zh: : 太棒了。不过我不确定那算不算秘密，因为我也去其他女孩的房间里玩。

lines.en: : Why would you let me set up a cute moment like that only to cut me down right after? Have you no shame, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你为什么让我铺垫好一个这么可爱的瞬间，紧接着又把我打落谷底？你到底有没有廉耻啊，Sensei？

lines.en: : I really don’t.
lines.zh: : 我真没有。

lines.en: scene black
Uta winks at me, but I’m pretty sure it’s a passive aggressive wink that she decided to break out in response to my sudden “betrayal.”
lines.zh: Uta 朝我眨了眨眼，不过我敢肯定那是被动攻击式的眨眼，是她为了回应我突如其来的“背叛”才决定拿出来的。

lines.en: Either way, it’s cute.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，很可爱。

lines.en: She spins around and her skirt flies up in the process, but she’s wearing leggings so I’m unable to catch a glimpse of anything interesting.
lines.zh: : 她转了个身，裙子随之扬起，不过她穿着打底裤，所以我什么有趣的都没看到。

lines.en: I follow behind her as she plops onto the bed stomach-first but, just as I’m about to take a seat beside her (Welcome or not), I notice something peculiar.
lines.zh: 我跟着她走过去，她趴着扑到床上；可就在我准备（不管欢不欢迎）在她旁边坐下时，我注意到了一样奇特的东西。

lines.en: scene utafirstdormleonard
: What is this?
lines.zh: : 这是什么？

lines.en: : Hm?
: Oh, that?
lines.zh: : 哦，那个啊？

lines.en: : Leonard.
lines.zh: : Leonard。

lines.en: : A...stag beetle?
lines.zh: : 一只……锹甲？

lines.en: : Rhinoceros beetle, technically.
lines.zh: : 严格说来是独角仙。

lines.en: : And where did you procure this creature?
lines.zh: : 那你是从哪儿弄来这玩意儿的？

lines.en: : Remember that flea market where I got all those essential oils?
lines.zh: : 还记得我买那些精油的跳蚤市场吗？

lines.en: : You bought a rhinoceros beetle at a flea market?
lines.zh: : 你在跳蚤市场买了只独角仙？

lines.en: : Oh, no. But I found him on the way back and carried him home in my pocket.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是。不过我在回来的路上发现了它，就把它揣在口袋里带回家了。

lines.en: : It’s freezing out. Poor little guy would have probably died if it weren’t for me.
lines.zh: : 外面冷得要命。要不是我，这小家伙大概就冻死了。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm13
: Go on. Tell me how caring and adorable I am for taking in such a delicate lil’ guy.
lines.zh: : 来吧。说说我收留了这么一个脆弱的小家伙，有多体贴多可爱。

lines.en: : You picked up a bug off the ground and carried it home.
lines.zh: : 你从地上捡了只虫子带回家。

lines.en: : I like to think I picked up sadness and taught it to smile.
lines.zh: : 我更愿意说，我捡起了一团悲伤，然后教会了它微笑。

lines.en: : What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思？

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm14
: It means Leonard is my buddy and if I was forced to choose between you and him-
lines.zh: : 意思是 Leonard 是我的好兄弟，如果非要我在你和他之间选一个——

lines.en: : I’d probably still choose you. But it would take a little bit of thought since he kinda depends on me and you have Ami.
lines.zh: : 我大概还是会选你。不过得稍微纠结一下，因为他比较依赖我，而你还有 Ami。

lines.en: : Oh, how’s she doing at the cafe, by the way?
lines.zh: : 哦，对了，她在咖啡厅干得怎么样？

lines.en: : Ami? She’s doing pretty good. She’s kind of already better in the kitchen than I am.
lines.zh: : Ami？她干得挺好的。在厨房里，她某种程度上已经比我强了。

lines.en: : But since she’s got those twintails we’d be fools to not take advantage of ‘em.
lines.zh: : 不过既然她有那对双马尾，我们要是不好好利用一下，那可就太傻了。

lines.en: : That hairstyle’s a hot commodity among the few men we actually get.
lines.zh: : 在我们为数不多的男客人里，那个发型可是抢手货。

lines.en: : She’s not actually trying to pull off a tsundere persona, is she?
lines.zh: : 她该不会真打算走傲娇人设吧？

lines.en: : She’s joked about that in the past but I’m not sure if it’s actually a thing she was going to follow through with or not.
lines.zh: : 她以前拿这事开过玩笑，不过我不确定她是不是真打算贯彻下去。

lines.en: : Oh, not at all. She’s a sweetheart. One of those clumsy types that always {i}almost{/i} trips when she’s carrying a tray but then somehow recovers at the last second.
lines.zh: : 哦，完全不是。她是个小甜心。就是那种笨手笨脚的类型——端着托盘的时候总是{i}差一点{/i}就要摔倒，然后又在最后一刻莫名其妙地稳住。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that’s just her being clumsy.
lines.zh: : 我敢说那只是因为她本来就笨手笨脚。

lines.en: : Well, it’s cute.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过很可爱。

lines.en: : She’s still got a bit to learn, though. Like, she’s got the “Master” thing down, but some people like being called other stuff and she’s still not comfortable with that.
lines.zh: : 她还有不少要学的。比如说，“主人”这个称呼她已经叫得很顺了，可有些人喜欢被叫别的，而她对此还不太自在。

lines.en: : Other stuff? What kind of other stuff?
lines.zh: : 别的？什么样的别的？

lines.en: : You know. Like “Prince” or “Oniichan.”
lines.zh: : 你懂的。比如“王子殿下”或者“哥哥”。

lines.en: : I don’t like the idea of either of you calling random guys “Oniichan.”
lines.zh: : 我可不喜欢你们俩随便叫陌生男人“哥哥”。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm15
: Ohohoh~ Are you getting jealous, Oniichan?
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵~你这是吃醋了吗，哥哥？

lines.en: : You don’t want Uta-chan and your [niece] spending time with other boys?
lines.zh: : 你不想让 Uta 酱和你的[niece]跟别的男生待在一起？

lines.en: : Don’t tease me when I’m just trying to protect you.
lines.zh: : 我只是在保护你们，别拿这个取笑我。

lines.en: : Protect us from what, Oniichan? Why do we need your protection?
lines.zh: : 保护我们免受什么，哥哥？我们为什么需要你的保护？

lines.en: : You know I have an actual older brother, right? I call him Oniichan, too.
lines.zh: : 你知道我是有亲哥哥的吧？我也叫他哥哥。

lines.en: : Is he in trouble?
lines.zh: : 他有麻烦吗？

lines.en: : Are you gonna break into prison and beat him up?
lines.zh: : 你要闯进监狱去揍他吗？

lines.en: : No, I’m going to-
lines.zh: : 不，我要——

lines.en: : Wait, prison? What?
lines.zh: : 等等，监狱？什么？

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm16
: He was dumb. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 他干了蠢事。别操心了。

lines.en: : Fact is, though, long as the two of us are working somewhere like that, we’re gonna have to go a little out of our comfort zone.
lines.zh: : 不过事实是，只要我和 Ami 还在那种地方工作，我们就得稍微走出自己的舒适区一点。

lines.en: : But who we are in there doesn’t mean anything if it’s not who we are on the outside.
lines.zh: : 可是我们在里面扮演的那个人，如果不是我们在外面的样子，那就毫无意义。

lines.en: : If I call somebody “Oniichan” or “Master” I’m really just trying to get into their pockets.
lines.zh: : 如果我叫谁“哥哥”或者“主人”，我真的只是在想办法掏他们的钱包。

lines.en: : That’s good to hear but, at the same time, you are really ruining the immersion for me right now.
lines.zh: : 听你这么说我就放心了，不过与此同时，你现在真是把我的代入感全毁了。

lines.en: : Never fear, Oniichan. Uta-chan’s off the clock right now and doesn’t mind being in character overtime for you~
lines.zh: : 别怕，哥哥。Uta 酱现在下班了，不介意为你加班加点地保持角色哦~

lines.en: : Sure, you might’ve seemed like just another guy the first time you came into the cafe, but you’re more than that now.
lines.zh: : 当然，你第一次进咖啡厅的时候也许只是个普通的客人，可你现在不止于此了。

lines.en: : You’re a special customer who needs {i}special{/i} service, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 你是一位需要{i}特殊{/i}服务的特殊顾客，如果你懂我意思的话。

lines.en: : Under normal pretenses, I feel like I would know that. But every time you say something suggestive, you immediately backpedal.
lines.zh: : 正常情况下，我觉得我该懂的。可每次你说了点暗示的话，你立刻就往回缩。

lines.en: scene utafirstdorm17
: Suggestive?! Sensei- me?! I have no idea what you’re talking about!
lines.zh: : 暗示？！Sensei——我？！我完全不知道你在说什么！

lines.en: : To assume I’d {i}suggest{/i} something in my room while sprawled out on the bed with my little feet dangling in the air, you’re a real rascal!
lines.zh: : 竟然以为我会在自己房间里、四仰八叉地躺在床上、小脚丫悬在空中的时候{i}暗示{/i}什么，你可真是个坏蛋！

lines.en: : Don’t get me wrong, I’m flattered you feel that way about me, but if I wanted to do any more I would have already tossed these clothes into the pile you’re standing on.
lines.zh: : 别误会，你能对我有那种想法我挺受宠若惊的，可如果我想做更多，我早就把这些衣服扔到你正站着的那堆上面了。

lines.en: : Are you sure? Leonard is watching.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？Leonard 正看着呢。

lines.en: : He’s gonna have to grow up eventually! Better he learned from his parents than some video on the Internet!
lines.zh: : 他总有一天得长大！让他从父母这儿学，总比从网上的什么视频里学强！

lines.en: scene black
And that, kids, is how I became the adoptive father of a rhinoceros beetle.
lines.zh: 就是这样，孩子们——我就是这样成了一只独角仙的养父的。

lines.en: scene theend
$ utadorm5 = True
$ uta_love += 1
{i}Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}
